*F-KE* (Key exchange, authenticated KE) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti and Krawczyk. [*Universally composable notions of key exchange and secure channels*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2002/059). In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2002, volume 2332 of LNCS, pages 337–351, 2002.
- Canetti and Krawczyk. [*Analysis of key-exchange protocols and their use for building secure channels*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2001/040). In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2001, volume 2045 of LNCS, pages 453–474, 2001.
- Bellare and Rogaway. [*Entity authentication and key distribution*](https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~mihir/projects/eakd.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 1993, volume 773 of LNCS, pages 232–249, 1994.
